basics.name: Oscar Nevarez
basics.label: Engineering leader · AI agents in production · ex-CTO (Prixz), Tech Lead Manager at Kamina GO (Grupo Traxión)
basics.summary: Engineering leader with 20+ years of hands-on work and a CTO tenure at Prixz (Mexico's first native online pharmacy) and, most recently, Tech Lead Manager at Kamina GO (Grupo Traxión), where the team shipped AI document intelligence, an internal LLM agent and multi-tenant analytics into daily operations at 5,000+ logistics movements a day. Builds with MCP servers, computer-use and voice agents, Rust and Tauri. Looking to lead an AI engineering organisation: Head of AI, Director of Engineering or Engineering Manager, remote across the Americas or hybrid in Mexico City.

work.name: Kamina GO (Grupo Traxión)
work.summary: Led technology for a freight marketplace and execution platform inside one of Mexico's largest logistics and mobility groups, running 5,000+ logistics movements a day. Owned architecture, priorities and the engineering team.
highlights: Led the team that built mobile proof-of-delivery capture with validation, OCR and AI contextual extraction, exception handling, invoice management and reconciliation, and payment follow-up.
Custom POD and evidence routers handling varied document layouts through content extraction and per-document model routing.
Multimedia evidence management system accepting audio, video and images, interpreting them with AI and feeding several downstream systems.
Internal AI agent spanning datasets and APIs across business areas, used through a simple Slack interface.
Multi-tenant dashboards and analytics on Athena and Metabase.
Broker–shipper matching and brokerage flows connected to lending.

work.name: Prixz
work.summary: Chief Technology Officer at Mexico's first native online pharmacy: no physical stores, dark-store fulfilment, own site and app plus Amazon and Mercado Libre storefronts, grown out of a last-mile delivery operation. Owned the technology organisation and platform.
highlights: Led engineering for a healthtech e-commerce and delivery business during its growth from last-mile provider to digital pharmacy.
Owned architecture, platform and hiring decisions as the company's senior technology leader.

work.name: ONE VAREZ (independent consulting)
work.position: Software engineer, data architect, AI specialist
work.summary: Software development, data architecture and AI solutions for clients across 20+ years; 100+ projects delivered. Cloud and serverless architecture on AWS and GCP, PHP/Laravel platforms, Node/TypeScript services, data pipelines.
highlights: Serverless and container platforms with infrastructure as code (CDK, CloudFormation, buildpacks).
Data and document pipelines, from crawlers to extraction and analytics.
